text:
Hey everyone Shabbat Shalom

My partner and I are organizing the files for Misrad Hapnim before submitting our application. We have some questions:
My partner is from Ireland and there isn’t an official personal status document issued in there (we have a signed letter from the embassy certifying it). 

We currently have an affidavit, based on the general format in Misrad Hamishpatim (https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/generalpage/patents-floating-page/he/patents_patents_department_floating-page_declaration-example.docx) 

signed in English and Hebrew by my partner and a lawyer. 

We wanted to know if that is enough? Do we need a notary instead? Does it need an apostle? Does the current affidavit format legit for the visa process? 
Or any relevant information regarding it 🙏🏻

Thank you all in advance
Itai
